result.summary: The page layout is mostly clean; found 1 minor styling inconsistency in the heart/favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white circular background while the one on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating inconsistent styling between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
